name: Business Future Today
tagline: Business, technology and what matters next.

concept.name: Edition
concept.description: A premium editorial identity: serif authority for the publication name, disciplined sans-serif support typography, and a framed BFT compact mark.

rules.compactMark: Framed BFT only. No TODAY line inside compact marks.
rules.wordmark: Business Future in serif, TODAY in spaced sans-serif, restrained accent rule.
rules.minimumClearspace: Keep at least one BFT cap-height around the mark or wordmark.
doNot: Do not stretch or condense the mark.
Do not add shadows or gradients to the logo.
Do not replace the approved brand colors inside the mark.
rules.profileCrop: Social profile assets use an inset framed BFT mark sized to remain fully visible inside circular platform crops.
